_comment: Verified in local_sim/ (pure-Python, no ROS/PX4/GPU): completes all 26 legs with the depth-based safety stop active and no false stops/deadlocks. Derived from dronehacks-course-v3.obj via A* over a 32cm-inflated occupancy grid. Launch->Gate B, does NOT use the window bonus (+5 pts). Confirmed assumption: drone launch heading faces +Y in the course OBJ frame (into the first corridor). Tightest point: ~33cm raw clearance to a C1-chicane-wall corner (leg 17) -- re-verify once the real airframe span is known; 25cm was used as a placeholder drone radius in local_sim.

params._param_note: Defaults (corridor_half_m 0.6, stop_m 0.9) are wider/longer than this maze's ~1m corridors and short legs allow, and false-stop on leg 3 in local_sim. min_corridor_coverage was lowered from the 0.6 default because a level, non-tilted camera gets little/no depth return down genuinely open stretches of this small course -- a real fix would angle the camera down slightly (allowed by rule 3.2) to get a steadier floor return instead of relying on this looser threshold. See local_sim/README.md.
params._vault_note: Rohan's wall-vault maneuver (refnav/core.py) is in this branch but left OFF here (vault_on_obstacle defaults to false) -- it climbs over a wall instead of stopping, which costs rule 7.7's 15%-credit penalty if triggered mid-maze. Looks built for the optional return-over-the-barrier bonus (rule 7.10), not for in-maze obstacle handling. Opt in deliberately per-run, don't flip this on globally without the team agreeing it's for the return leg specifically.
